meta.title: Strategy Leaderboard — rules, scoring, rewards
meta.status: DESIGN PUBLISHED — competition opens once the pick ledger exists (S3). No entries yet; the table below is the scaffold.
meta.principle: Rank selectively skill-based strategies, not lucky ones. Raw ROI never determines rewards on its own (R10).

competition.unit: 1 unit = 1% of a notional 100-unit bankroll (paper units; owner may set real budget — Q11)
eligibility: Strategy registered with a unique ID and pre-kickoff lock (G1)
All inputs from verified rows or labelled MODEL OUTPUT (G2)

scoring.rawROI: net units / units staked, per graded pick
scoring.clvScore: mean(closing value of taken price) when market snapshots exist; otherwise excluded and noted
scoring.skillScore: 100 * (0.6 * z(shrunkROI) + 0.4 * z(clvScore)) over the active field; z = standard score within season, min 100 picks for full weight
scoring.processGate: any rule-violation week voids that week from scoring

antiLuck: Rewards require 95% bootstrap CI of ROI to clear zero (G5)
Parlays count as their leg count for sample size
One lucky outlier week is winsorized at the 99th percentile of weekly ROI before scoring
Rank display shows n and CI width beside every strategy so readers see precision

rewards.status: PROPOSAL — needs owner decision (Q11). Defaults below are placeholders, not commitments.

tiers.rewardProposed: Named season champion + review-priority for strategy ideas

rewards.rule: No reward is paid to a strategy whose skillScore CI includes zero, regardless of raw rank.
